tokenize_line: tokenize a line of text by normalizing whitespace and splitting into tokens
tokenize_line_strip: tokenize a line of text and strip leading and trailing whitespace before splitting
tokenize_line_normalize: tokenize a line of text by collapsing multiple spaces into a single space
review_tokenize_line: review the tokenize_line function to understand how whitespace normalization and splitting work
summarize_SPACE_NORMALIZER: summarize the SPACE_NORMALIZER regex pattern used for collapsing whitespace in text
